content.question: Padhai ke baad wapas aaoge na?

answers.title: Seedhi baat karo
answers.detail: Abhi jo plan hai, wo honestly batao. Ghar walon ko surprise pasand nahi.

answers.title: Plan badal sakta hai
answers.detail: Job, rules aur mauke dekh ke faisla hoga. Ye baat pehle se saath mein maan ke chalo.

answers.title: Rishta wahi rahega
answers.detail: Kahin bhi raho, roz ki baat aur tyohaar pe call. Doori sirf map pe hai.
